report.answer: Retested 24 recorded/planted absences on this tree. 7 are detector failures (wrong shell/path/field, stale cache, or missing git metadata); 5 are false absences (the item is present); 10 are confirmed absences after a known-present control hit; 1 downgraded to NOT-CHECKED (no control); 1 are recall-not-detection. Naive repo-wide grep for 'unified-continuation' is a false absence (the catalog quotes the claim). Implementation-scoped grep is a confirmed absence only when catalog/self/quote files are the only hits; on this tree it is a false absence. git log zeros are detector failures because .git is absent.
